subject: general
question: What is the primary goal of the BIMSTEC Free Trade Area (FTA)?

options.text: To reduce trade barriers and enhance economic cooperation
To establish a common currency among BIMSTEC nations

solution:
The correct answer is __**To reduce trade barriers and enhance economic cooperation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The BIMSTEC Free Trade Area (FTA) aims to strengthen economic cooperation among member states by **reducing trade barriers** such as tariffs and quotas.
 
• It promotes **regional integration** by facilitating the free movement of goods and services between BIMSTEC countries.
